name: mini-logistics
description: 2D procedural world generator and multi-modal transportation logistics simulator inspired by OpenTTD and Mini Motorways

scripts.test: bun test tests/unit && bunx playwright test
scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script src/ tests/ scripts/ playwright.config.js index.html
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --no-script --check src/ tests/ scripts/ playwright.config.js index.html
scripts.check: bun fmt --no-script --check src/ tests/ scripts/ playwright.config.js index.html && bunx oxlint --deny-warnings src/ tests/ scripts/ && bun check --no-script && bun test --check tests/unit && bunx playwright test
